title: Compact decision snapshots + variant-scorebook for cross-region/tier routing observability
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce a compact, sampled snapshot format and an auxiliary 'variant-scorebook' to improve runtime observability of routing decisions across region selection, capacity tiering, and fallback model variants. Goal is to make RCA and SLO attribution faster while containing telemetry volume and avoiding dense PII. Deliverables: a binary-lite snapshot schema (<=2KB typical) stored as a span attachment, a variant-scorebook index written to the routing ledger for quick lookups, sampling controls for hot paths, and Console views that correlate snapshots with per-hop metrics and model variant scores. This ticket covers design, a small PoC, integration with tracing, and a gated rollout with privacy filters and cost limits.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and approved by Observability and Runtime teams
Binary-lite snapshot schema defined with max size budget of 2KB when sample-compressed
Variant-scorebook design that maps model variant ids to short score vectors and decision-reason tags
PoC integrated into staging with trace attachments for at least 1% sampled requests and no more than 5% additional latency p50
Console Decision Explorer shows snapshot -> per-hop metrics correlation and variant score breakdown
Privacy scrubber strips user prompts and customer IDs from stored snapshots before persistence
Feature flag + sampling config added and documented; default sampling <=0.1% in production
Load test demonstrates telemetry volume increase kept under 1.5x baseline for common workloads
comments: 2026-02-21 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes added. Focus on compactness and privacy. Agreed to prototype two encodings: CBOR-lite and delta-encoded JSON. Action: Marcus to spin up a 3-day spike.

2026-02-26 - Marcus Nguyen: Spike complete. CBOR-lite gives ~40% smaller payloads than gzipped JSON for typical routing frames. CBOR decoder added to trace agent. Found edge-case when KV cache context grows >8k tokens; we will cap context serialization and include a tombstone flag.

2026-03-02 - Leah Kim (SRE): Load test in staging with 1% sampling showed p50 token latency increase of 2.1% and p95 increase of 4.7% — within our SLO; storage ingestion throughput needs a batching buffer to avoid bursts. Filed follow-up ENG-61311 for buffering layer.

2026-03-05 - Design review (Observability): Decided to keep model logits out of snapshots and instead store normalized variant scores (3 floats) to avoid leaking model internals. Security asked for end-to-end encryption for long-term store keys. Marcus to add KMS integration checklist.

2026-03-09 - Marcus Nguyen: Created initial PR with encoder/decoder and a Console mock (github.com/redwood-inference/routing-telemetry/pull/187). Need UX polish on Decision Explorer view; PM provided feedback to include 'route-commit-id' and 'fallback-reason' tags in snapshot header.

2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel: Updated acceptance criteria to add explicit scrub rule for user-generated text and to set default sampling to 0.1% in production config. Planning rollout: canary to 5% of hosts, observe telemetry cost for one billing cycle before full enablement.
